meta.source: k0/schedule.csv + k0/leaves.csv (3704 nodes, 990 leaves); compiled by k0/compile_schedule.py

binding.gpu: single GPU: all GEMV row ranges are FULL [0, nrows); the dual-GPU compile parameterizes rows by the meta split
binding.sequence: single sequence (k=0): zero-extent clear chains and the dead rs_index_setup views are dropped (SCHEDULE-QUESTIONS items 14/15, a design decision the capture alone does not prove safe)
binding.mask: the f32->f16 mask conversion (n219) is host-side: the harness writes cell:mask_f16 (0 / -inf, width n_kv) directly; the f32 mask leaf l65 is not materialized
binding.q_heads: 24 q-heads x 4 kv-heads, head_dim 256 (measured, QUESTIONS item 1; the briefed 32 is wrong)

mapping.rmsnorm: OP_RMSNORM (fused weight mul; residual_add folds in as the optional add-src, sum written back to residual)
mapping.residual_add: folded into the following OP_RMSNORM (add_src); no OP_RESIDUAL_ADD instructions are emitted
mapping.kv_append: OP_KV_APPEND (K and V SET_ROWS in one instruction)
mapping.fattn_prep: folded into OP_FATTN_DECODE args (views/permutes become strides)
mapping.fattn_decode: OP_FATTN_DECODE (+ inserted OP_FATTN_REDUCE for the split-KV merge)
mapping.logits_row_select: folded into the epilogue OP_RMSNORM source select (batch-1 identity), NOT the head GEMV: the row select precedes the final norm
mapping.inserted: OP_QUANT_Q8_1 (before every quantized-weight GEMV group), OP_FATTN_REDUCE, OP_LOGITS_EMIT carry no source nodes; dbg_node points at the anchor node

namespaces.cache:: per-layer cache tensor: cache_k_l<i>, cache_v_l<i> (f16 1024 x 262144), state_r_l<i> (f32 30720), state_s_l<i> (f32 786432)
namespaces.buf:: scratch buffer from the buffers table
namespaces.sym:$: runtime scalar the host patches into the instruction payload per pass

runtime_symbols.$kv_row: destination cache row for this token's KV append (i64; one value, shared by all 16 attention layers)
runtime_symbols.$rs_row: recurrent-state row for the active sequence (i32; constant under the single-sequence binding but kept symbolic)
runtime_symbols.$out_row: epilogue row select; always 0 at batch-1
runtime_symbols.$seqno: (--split) monotonic per-site exchange seqno = pass number; host patches each OP_XCHG_REDUCE payload/pass
runtime_symbols.$gpu_index: (--split) 0 or 1; selects the fixed p0+p1 fold order; pack-time constant per GPU

input_cells.positions: i32[4] M-RoPE position ids for this token
input_cells.n_kv: u32[1] current KV window length, padded to a multiple of 256; host-written once per pass, read STRONG (.cg) by OP_FATTN_DECODE so a deep-context change is never a stale cached-payload read
input_cells.mask_f16: f16[n_kv] KQ mask, 0 attend / -inf masked, host-written
input_cells.done_flag: host completion flag set by OP_LOGITS_EMIT

drops.reason: dead rs_index_setup views; outputs unreferenced in-graph (QUESTIONS item 15; single-sequence k=0 binding)
mask f32->f16 conversion moved host-side: the harness/backend writes the f16 mask (cell:mask_f16) directly

dram_bytes.note: scratch/activation traffic excluded (L2-resident, < 10 MB/pass); weights counted once per pass at logical (unpadded) size

buffers.name: q8_act
buffers.purpose: quantized activations for MMVQ; sized for the largest LOCAL quantized vector (the 8704-wide half FFN GLU output); rewritten several times/block

buffers.name: mixer_out
buffers.purpose: mixer GEMV output: attn q|gate (local 12x512=6144) or DN qkv (local 5120); on DN blocks reused for post-conv qkv (OP_SSM_CONV_SILU dst)

buffers.name: conv_ws
buffers.purpose: conv concat window [d_conv=4 x local channels]

buffers.name: gdn_alpha
buffers.purpose: ssm_alpha GEMV out; becomes g = softplus(alpha+dt_bias)*a in place

buffers.name: gdn_beta
buffers.purpose: ssm_beta GEMV out; becomes sigmoid(beta) in place

buffers.name: attn_out
buffers.purpose: mixer output vector: GDN token out / FATTN merged out; gated in place

buffers.name: k_stage
buffers.purpose: current-token K row; normed+roped in place

buffers.name: fattn_q
buffers.purpose: compact roped q (local heads x 256), deinterleaved from mixer_out

buffers.name: fattn_partial
buffers.purpose: split-KV partials: 72 splits x local heads x (256 vkq + max + sumexp)

buffers.name: proj_out
buffers.purpose: block output projection (ssm_out / attn_output / ffn_down) partial, reduced in place to the mirrored residual fold (next OP_RMSNORM add_src)

buffers.name: logits
buffers.purpose: lm head output (this GPU's vocab half)

args.note: row_select folds the epilogue GET_ROWS (batch-1: always row 0 of a 1-row trunk)
